decisions_log.decision: Used simple text ('Link' / 'Copied') rather than an icon for the CopyButton label states.
decisions_log.rationale: Icon choice is explicitly listed as a deferred decision in the sketch. Using text avoids resolving that decision and keeps the component dependency-free.

decisions_log.decision: Placed slugify in lib/slugify.ts as a named export rather than inlining it in ChangelogEntry.tsx.
decisions_log.rationale: task.md explicitly specifies lib/slugify.ts. A standalone export is also directly unit-testable without rendering any component.

decisions_log.decision: CopyButton constructs the full URL at click-time using window.location.href split on '#'.
decisions_log.rationale: Avoids threading the current path through server→client props. Stripping the existing fragment before appending the new one prevents double-hash URLs if the visitor navigated from another anchor.

decisions_log.decision: ChangelogEntry remains without 'use client'; CopyButton carries its own 'use client' boundary.
decisions_log.rationale: Matches the existing pattern where Tooltip (a client component) is consumed by ChangelogEntry (a server component). Keeps the entry renderable as an RSC.

deferred_questions.question: Should the CopyButton show an icon (e.g. a Lucide link icon) instead of the text 'Link' in its default state?

files_changed.summary: Exports `slugify(title)`: lowercase, strip non-alphanumeric, replace spaces with hyphens, collapse runs. Used by ChangelogEntry to derive anchor IDs.

'use client' button component. Accepts a `slug` prop, writes `window.location.href.split('#')[0] + '#' + slug` to clipboard on click, shows 'Copied' for 2 s then reverts to 'Link'. aria-label='Copy permalink to this entry'. Muted zinc Tailwind styling.

Imports `slugify` and `CopyButton`. Computes `slug = slugify(entry.title)`, applies it as `id` on the `<h2>`, and renders `<CopyButton slug={slug} />` inline between the title and the reading-time span.
17 tests: 9 `slugify` unit tests, 2 ChangelogEntry integration tests (AC1), 6 CopyButton unit tests (AC2, AC3). Mocks navigator.clipboard and uses jest fake timers for the 2-second revert.

self_assessment.notes: All 124 tests pass (107 pre-existing + 17 new). Lint and production build are clean. No new external dependencies introduced. changelog.json and /changelog.xml route are untouched. The 'Link' text label is a stand-in pending the deferred icon decision; swapping it for an icon requires only a one-line change to CopyButton.tsx.
